projectDescription: Neuramine is a private AI platform that lets you run LLMs, speech-to-text, and text-to-speech entirely on your own hardware — with a polished chat interface and an OpenAI-compatible API, and zero data sent to third-party AI vendors.
keyFeatures: BYOG (Bring Your Own GPU) — connect any machine as the inference backend with zero inbound ports
OpenAI-compatible API — drop-in replacement, change only base_url and api_key
Private inference — all AI runs on your hardware, Neuramine cloud handles routing only
LLM, STT, and TTS support — full voice conversations on-device
RAG knowledge base — upload documents and ask questions about them
Long-term memory — mem0 remembers facts and preferences across conversations
3-layer system prompt architecture — platform, vertical compliance, and workspace customization
HIPAA/PIPEDA compliance — AES-256 encryption, 6-year audit logs, per-workspace data isolation
Multi-hardware support — NVIDIA GPU (vLLM), Apple Silicon (Metal), and CPU (llama.cpp)
publicApiSurface: POST /v1/chat/completions — OpenAI-compatible LLM inference, streaming supported
POST /v1/audio/transcriptions — STT in OpenAI Whisper format
POST /v1/audio/speech — TTS in OpenAI TTS format
GET /v1/memory — list mem0 facts for this workspace
DELETE /v1/memory/{id} — delete a specific memory fact
POST /v1/documents — upload document to knowledge base
DELETE /v1/documents/{id} — remove document from knowledge base
